requirements.description: Historical firm headquarters input `hq.dta`, keyed by GVKEY-year and containing county FIPS and CIK for the supplied treatment construction.

routes.description: COMP.COMPANY is a readable current company table with gvkey, cik, county, sic and state; it lacks the required year-indexed county_fips history and the county-to-FIPS mapping is not established.
routes.expected_period: Current company record only; historical GVKEY-year county coverage is required.

routes.description: The latest SEDAR company block exposes recent HQ-address fields, not the required historical county-FIPS-by-GVKEY-year panel.
routes.expected_period: Latest address fields only; historical county-year records required.

requirements.description: Prepared BLM event input `blmprotests.dta` with county_fips, date, pid and pcount; the supplied code derives county-level first-event and annual protest measures.

routes.description: The paper page describes event time, location and protestor count, and the datasheet identifies the BLM source family as public. The exact compiled file, pid field, county-FIPS conversion and de-duplication contract are not established.
routes.expected_period: 2014–2021 event years used by the supplied map and sample code; exact source-file range and assembly remain unverified.

requirements.description: Director-level `dirname_gvkey-year-dir_full-results.dta` with gvkey, year, input_id and author-generated gpt_race labels.

routes.description: The local ExecuComp director roster has GVKEY, DIRNBR, DIRNAME and YEAR, but does not contain gpt_race and no exact DIRNBR-to-input_id or author-label mapping is established.
routes.expected_period: Director firm-year records; exact sample coverage is not established by the one-row read.

requirements.description: Executive-level `execname_gvkey-year-exec_full-results.dta` with gvkey, year, input_execid and author-generated gpt_race labels.

routes.description: The local ExecuComp annual executive roster has GVKEY, EXECID, YEAR, EXEC_FULLNAME and GENDER, but no gpt_race; the exact EXECID-to-input_execid and classification-output mapping is not established.
routes.expected_period: Executive firm-year records; exact sample coverage is not established by the one-row read.

requirements.description: Employee race-count input `emp_cik-year.dta`, keyed by CIK-year with n_white, n_api, n_hispanic and n_black.

routes.description: The catalogued Revelio workforce_dynamics_geo product is aggregated by company/geography/month and has fields such as rcid, state, count, inflow/outflow and datemonth; it lacks CIK, calendar year and the four race-specific counts, so it is not a compatible substitute.
routes.expected_period: Monthly geographic aggregate; author input requires CIK-year race counts.

requirements.description: Historical CIK-to-GVKEY link input `cik-gvkey_linking.dta`, transformed to one CIK-year-GVKEY row for the employee merge.

routes.description: The readable WRDSSEC.WCIKLINK_GVKEY product supplies CIK, GVKEY and link start/end dates. Expand valid intervals to calendar years, standardize identifiers and resolve any overlapping links before the supplied one-to-one CIK-year merge.
routes.expected_period: Historical link intervals must cover the retained employee panel years (the code drops years before 1990); one-row probe does not establish coverage.

requirements.description: Employee state-year race-count input `emp_cik-state-year.dta`, keyed by CIK-state-year with sn_white, sn_api, sn_hispanic and sn_black.

routes.description: The readable catalog schema includes state but represents monthly geographic aggregates and contains no CIK, calendar year or race-specific employee counts; it is not a compatible state-year employee-race panel.
routes.expected_period: Monthly aggregate; author input requires CIK-state-year race counts.

requirements.description: Annual Compustat input with GVKEY/CIK, datadate/fyear, the supplied accounting and market fields, and both sic/sich fields consumed by the code.

routes.description: COMP.FUNDA is readable and contains the annual financial fields in the bounded selected schema, including sich but not exact sic. The supplied code destrings sic before its conditional sich fallback; the correct historical SIC mapping requires confirmation.
routes.expected_period: Annual observations required for the supplied GVKEY-year analysis; exact source dates are not established by one sampled row.

routes.description: COMP.COMPANY has sic but is a current company table without the annual Compustat financial fields or historical year index; it cannot alone supply compustat.dta.

requirements.description: Prepared Refinitiv firm-year input with ric, gvkey, year, dir_diver_score, policy_diveropp_d, target_diveropp_d, bod_genderdiver and exe_genderdiver.

routes.description: The readable TRESG company/social table uses OrgId and FisYear plus product-specific ESG identifiers; no exact OrgId-to-RIC/GVKEY, fiscal-to-calendar-year or supplied metric mapping is established.
routes.expected_period: Fiscal-year company records; mapping and period alignment unresolved.

routes.description: The readable TRESG board-member table uses OrgID, MemberID and FisYear with board-member gender/cultural-diversity measures; it is not the supplied firm-year RIC/GVKEY metric panel and has no verified mapping.
routes.expected_period: Fiscal-year member-level records; firm-year mapping unresolved.

requirements.description: State-year community representation input `community_rep.dta` with black_pct, nonblackm_pct and white_pct.

routes.description: ACS provides public county/state data access, but the exact table, variable definitions, denominator and vintage that produce the code-required community_rep state-year fields are not specified.
routes.expected_period: State-years required by the supplied community benchmark; exact vintages are unresolved.

requirements.description: County-year demographic input with population/race/poverty/labor-force/education fields plus density, median household income and Gini used by the supplied county controls.

routes.description: Official ACS API documentation supports public county retrieval, but the supplied code does not identify the exact ACS tables, measure definitions, vintage choices, or the source of county_gini needed to produce county-dem.dta.
routes.expected_period: County-years required by main-master; exact year/vintage mapping is unresolved.

requirements.description: Table 2 firm-year workforce join/leave input with CIK, GVKEY, year and race-specific new-hire and leave-in/leave-out counts.

routes.description: The catalogued Revelio geo/month aggregate has no person-level firm-year history or the supplied race-specific appointment/departure counts; no producer for emp_gvkey-year_join-leave.dta is included in the package.
routes.expected_period: Appendix describes individual histories and excludes 2021 from its replacement probability estimation because 2022 was incomplete at the time; exact input window still requires author mapping.

requirements.description: The 2018 US county TIGER/Line shapefile and its required shapefile sidecars; the supplied map code joins on GEOID, reads STATEFP and uses county geometry.

routes.description: Official Census 2018 TIGER/Line county archive supplies the named tl_2018_us_county shapefile product; use the bundled attribute and coordinate sidecars. The code creates Stata database/coordinate intermediates with shp2dta before the map consumer.
routes.expected_period: 2018 county geography, matching the supplied map program.

The packaged geo workbook and GVKEY identifier list do not supply these contracts. evidence.description: README specifies Stata and lists user-written commands for the supplied workflow.
evidence.quote:
* **Stata** 16 or later.
* Install the following user-written commands before running:

  ```stata
  ssc install reghdfe, replace
  ssc install ftools, replace   // dependency for reghdfe
  ssc install asreg, replace
  ssc install winsor, replace
  ssc install carryforward, replace
  ssc install astile, replace
  ssc install ebalance, replace
  ssc install shp2dta, replace
    ```
* All `.do` files begin with `set more off`.

evidence.description: README lists the prepared input filenames consumed by the supplied workflow.
evidence.quote:
* `hq.dta` (headquarters county FIPS by GVKEY–year)
* `blmprotests.dta` (county-date protest counts)
* `dirname_gvkey-year-dir_full-results.dta` (director-level race/ethnicity predictions)
* `execname_gvkey-year-exec_full-results.dta` (executive-level race/ethnicity predictions)
* `emp_cik-year.dta`, `emp_cik-state-year.dta` (employee counts by race)
* `cik-gvkey_linking.dta`

* `emp_gvkey-year_join-leave.dta` (join/leave counts by race; used for Table 2)

evidence.description: README gives the master-data, replacement, regression and figure workflow order.
evidence.quote:
2. **Build the master dataset.**
   Run **`LT-sample construction.do`**.
   Key outputs:

   * `main-master.dta` (analysis dataset with treatment/status variables and controls)
   * sample flags (e.g., `esample_t2ab`, `esample_t2c`, `esample_t3`)
   * entropy-balancing weights

3. **Construct replacement matrices (Table 2).**
   Run **`LT-replacement probabilities.do`**.
   Key outputs:

   * `replacement_dir_gvkey-year.dta`
   * `replacement_exec_gvkey-year.dta`
   * `replacement_emp_gvkey-year.dta`
     The script also prints tabulations and t-tests used in Table 2.

4. **Generate tables/figures.**
   Run **`LT-regressions.do`** for Table 1 and Tables 3–7.

evidence.description: README describes an aggregated firm-year panel without names; it is not the individual-level classification inputs used by the supplied programs.
evidence.quote:
We share an **aggregated firm-year panel** (no names) spanning **2012–2021**:

* `gvkey` — Compustat firm identifier
* `year` — calendar year
* `% Black directors`
* `% non-Black minority directors` — Asian + Hispanic + Other
* `% White directors`
* `Director Diversity Index` — **1 − Σ s\_c²** using **five** categories (White, Black, Asian, Hispanic, Other)
* `% Black executives`
* `% non-Black minority executives` — Asian + Hispanic + Other

evidence.description: Sample construction reads hq.dta and retains GVKEY, county FIPS, year and CIK.
evidence.quote:
use "hq.dta", clear
	gsort gvkey cik year county_fips _all
	keep gvkey county_fips year cik

evidence.description: Sample construction reads the BLM event table and uses county FIPS, date, event identifier and protest count.
evidence.quote:
use "blmprotests.dta", clear
	gsort county_fips date pid _all
	gen n 											= _n
	gen neg_n 										= n*-1
	bys county_fips: egen earliest_pdate 			= min(date)
	gen dpcount_100 								= (pcount>=100)

evidence.description: Sample construction reads the director-level classification file and uses firm-year and input identifier fields with gpt_race.
evidence.quote:
use "dirname_gvkey-year-dir_full-results.dta" , clear
	gsort gvkey year input_id _all
	bys gvkey year: gen n 							= _n
	bys gvkey year: egen ndir 						= max(n)
	gen d_gpt_white 								= (gpt_race =="white")
	gen d_gpt_black 								= (gpt_race =="black")
	gen d_gpt_asian 								= (gpt_race =="asian")	
	gen d_gpt_hispanic 								= (gpt_race =="hispanic")
	gen d_gpt_other 								= (gpt_race =="other")

evidence.description: Sample construction reads the executive-level classification file and uses firm-year and input executive identifier fields with gpt_race.
evidence.quote:
use "execname_gvkey-year-exec_full-results.dta", clear
	gsort gvkey year input_execid _all
	bys gvkey year: gen n 							= _n
	bys gvkey year: egen nexec 						= max(n)
	gen d_gpt_white 								= (gpt_race =="white")
	gen d_gpt_black 								= (gpt_race =="black")
	gen d_gpt_asian 								= (gpt_race =="asian")
	gen d_gpt_hispanic 								= (gpt_race =="hispanic")

evidence.description: Sample construction reads employee counts by CIK-year, joins the separate CIK-GVKEY link file, and keeps the merged keys and race-count fields.
evidence.quote:
use "emp_cik-year.dta", clear
	merge 1:1 cik year using "cik-gvkey_linking.dta"
	drop if _merge==2
	drop _merge
	gsort cik year gvkey _all
	gen n = _n
	gen neg_n = n*-1
	bys cik (n): carryforward gvkey, replace
	bys cik (neg_n): carryforward gvkey, replace
	drop if gvkey ==.
	drop if year < 1990
	keep cik year n_* gvkey

evidence.description: Sample construction derives employee totals and race shares from the four employee race-count fields.
evidence.quote:
gen emp_n_emp 									= n_white + n_api + n_hispanic + n_black
	gen n_nonblackminor 							= (emp_n_emp - n_white) - n_black 
	gen emp_pct_white 								= n_white / emp_n_emp
	gen emp_pct_api 								= n_api / emp_n_emp
	gen emp_pct_hispanic 							= n_hispanic / emp_n_emp
	gen emp_pct_black 								= n_black / emp_n_emp

evidence.description: Sample construction merges state-year community representation and uses its race-share fields.

	gen pct_edu25_hs 								= edu25_hs / edu25
	gen pct_edu25_black_bachelor 					= edu25_black_bachelor / edu25_black

evidence.description: The datasheet says director and executive race classifications were generated using GPT-4 through the ChatGPT web interface.
evidence.quote:
•   Race/Ethnicity Classification Data: We generated race/ethnicity classifications
      for directors and executives by using their names as inputs for OpenAI’s GPT-4
      model via the ChatGPT web interface between March and April 2023. The process,
      which involved Chain-of-Thought prompting, is detailed in Section 3.2 and Online
      Appendix A.1.

evidence.description: The datasheet describes public-domain sources, institutional subscriptions for commercial datasets and a historical personal Revelio license; this is not evidence of a current access barrier.
evidence.quote:
BLM protest data, county- and state-level demographics, economic indicators, election
   data, and 10-K filings are in the public domain and publicly accessible.

   All other datasets, including Compustat, ExecuComp, Refinitiv, RepRisk, S&P Global,
   were accessed via institutional subscriptions through Nanyang Technological University
   during the course of the project.

   Revelio Labs granted us a non-transferable, personal license to access and analyze their
   proprietary data. Redistribution or transfer of these data to any third party is prohibited
   under the licensing agreement.

actions.description: Obtain or identify the author-prepared tables and exact field/history contracts for the unresolved inputs; do not infer substitutions from same-brand catalog products.
steps: For hq.dta, provide the historical GVKEY-year county-FIPS panel and its CIK link; current company and most-recent HQ products do not establish county history.
For BLM events, identify the exact public compiled file and document pid, event dates, protest counts and county-FIPS derivation before mapping it to blmprotests.dta.

Provide the director and executive gpt_race files with the original input identifier mapping, or the author’s complete prepared classification outputs; the local ExecuComp rosters do not contain gpt_race.

Provide the CIK-year and CIK-state-year workforce race-count tables and the separate firm-year join/leave panel, with Revelio product, record grain, category definitions and date coverage. The catalogued monthly geography aggregate is not a substitute.
For Compustat, confirm the code’s sic input against the local FUNDA sich field and the historical industry definition; a current company sic field does not supply annual fundamentals.

For Refinitiv, identify the exact RIC/GVKEY/year mapping and data dictionary for each diversity, policy, target and gender metric; the local TRESG candidates have different OrgId/FisYear/member-level schemas.
For community_rep.dta and county-dem.dta, supply the ACS table/measure-to-field mapping, numerator/denominator definitions, vintages and source for county Gini; then acquire the mapped public tables.
validation: Compare every delivered table’s native headers, key uniqueness, category definitions and calendar coverage against the cited Stata reads and joins.
Confirm the Table 2 join/leave producer and its individual-to-firm-year aggregation before running replacement probabilities.
Preserve the actual producer/consumer partial order: sample construction before main-master consumers, replacement matrices within the Table 2 branch, and separate map and Python figure branches.

validation: Check that the prepared table has one row per CIK-year where the code performs merge 1:1, and quantify unmatched/ambiguous links across the retained year range.

actions.description: Conditional procedure for all six supplied program entry points, following the evidenced producer/consumer partial order and keeping independent figure branches separate.
steps: Use a portable working copy. Before each Stata entry point, set its existing $path project-root macro to that copy and stage the named prepared inputs and writable relative output/log locations there; the screened macro value is not repeated or proposed as a source edit.

After the required data and software preconditions are met, run LT-sample construction.do first. It writes main-master.dta; confirm that product and its merge keys before running any supplied program that consumes it.

Run LT-replacement probabilities.do after sample construction for Table 2. It consumes main-master.dta, director/executive label panels and emp_gvkey-year_join-leave.dta, then writes replacement_dir_gvkey-year.dta, replacement_exec_gvkey-year.dta and replacement_emp_gvkey-year.dta. These are Table 2 outputs; do not make them prerequisites to a later program unless an actual consumer is established.

Run LT-regressions.do and LT-DiD plots.do after main-master.dta is produced. Their visible entry reads consume main-master.dta. The README lists replacement before regressions, but the supplied regression source does not establish a dependency on replacement outputs.

Run LT-protest maps.do as its own branch after blmprotests.dta and the 2018 TIGER shapefile plus sidecars are staged. Within that branch, shp2dta creates tl_2018_us_county.dta and us_counties_coord.dta before the GEOID join, STATEFP handling and spmap rendering.

Run LT-eco mag plot.py as an independent Python figure branch after the Python runtime and pandas/matplotlib/numpy packages are available. It constructs a DataFrame from in-program data and saves eco mag plot.png; no external data-file read is shown in the screened source.
validation: Before launch, verify each named input against its cited native fields, key uniqueness, period and construction contract, and resolve the unverified input/software routes separately.
Confirm main-master.dta exists before replacement, regression and DiD consumers; confirm the three replacement outputs as Table 2 results without inventing downstream edges.
Confirm the protest-map Stata intermediates preserve the five-character GEOID join and required STATEFP/geometry fields, and confirm the Python figure output at its relative path.
No supplied program was executed during this assessment; these are future validation steps after the input and software prerequisites are resolved.

review_notes: Scope remains full_pipeline and closure_complete is false. No separate analysis_only scope is supported by the packaged identifier list or the README-described aggregated firm-year panel; that panel has no names and is not a substitute for the classification inputs.

Assessment coverage limit only: byte-first screening withheld one-based physical DiD ranges 1–6, 101–112, 126–137 and 151–162, plus README lines 91 and 146–147. These are not labeled an author-program defect, missing code, access barrier or required author patch; the supplied DiD program remains in scope, and no withheld body was used to infer absence. Scope remains incomplete because the actual input contracts and some dependency coverage are unresolved.

A prior source-field comparison draft v1 associated probes too broadly. It was preserved; source_field_comparison_v2 corrected the table/probe associations and is the comparison audit basis, but neither comparison artifact is cited as supporting evidence here.

The bounded Revelio workforce geo SAS probe returned unverified and is preserved without supporting evidence. Two Stata add-on metadata attempts produced no markers; they are preserved without supporting evidence. Do not interpret either as proof of absence.
GPT-4 is historical label-generation context only. The supplied Stata code consumes prepared gpt_race inputs; no live model runtime or call is included in the supplied programs.

The successful one-row local probes establish readability and selected columns, not full sample population, year coverage or author-extract identity. The CIK-GVKEY route uses historical link intervals with calendar-year preparation; interval uniqueness and full required coverage remain validation checks.

No data were downloaded, no author program or software was executed, no source patch was proposed/applied, and no statistical or synthetic trial was performed. The 2018 TIGER route is an official public product acquisition; the exact compiled BLM and ACS variable mappings remain unresolved.
